sources.title: STT Tokyo 1 August 21 operator release confirming continuing operations
sources.summary: Dated Japanese operator release describes the facility it operates in Inzai and continuing carbon-neutral operations since service commencement. Its facility overview places Tokyo 1 within Goodman Business Park as the first of two STT campus buildings. August 21 is current-operation confirmation, not a construction completion, opening or certification grant date. Tokyo 2 opening remains a late-2027 forecast.

sources.title: STT Tokyo 1 August 21 English operator release
sources.summary: English counterpart confirms continuing operations since commencement. Up to 32 MW when fully operational and approximately 70 MW for the completed two-building campus are future or aggregate scope; neither is adopted as current operating load. Design PUE is not measured operating performance.

sources.title: STT Tokyo 1 factsheet currently linked by the operator
sources.summary: Page 1 names STT Tokyo 1 as the first of two buildings in its campus within Goodman Business Park. Page 2 lists 2-2-5 Kaguro-Minami, Inzai-shi, Chiba 270-1369. The URL indicates an April 2025 revision and copyright is 2025; exact publication day is unknown. Its LEED Gold (2024) label does not establish a grant day. No 32.4 MW, voltage, floor area or design PUE observation is normalized.

sources.title: STTGDC Tokyo locations and exact linked Tokyo 1 factsheet
sources.summary: Current operator page separately names Tokyo 1 and Tokyo 2 within the same STT campus at Goodman Business Park, marks Tokyo 2 under development, and links the captured exact Tokyo 1 factsheet. Retrieval does not refresh physical status and no Tokyo 2 status project is proposed.

sources.title: Google Maps selected named place: STT GDC STT Tokyo 1
sources.summary: Original public HTML contains selected-place identity STT GDC STT Tokyo 1, feature ID 0x60227d00058ce471:0x6a7f5e3a91b8fee5, entity /g/11n567bc0p and explicit selected-place latitude 35.8173944 and longitude 140.134879. The selected-object tuple, rather than map viewport or search query coordinates, supplies a labelled property marker. The raw HTML does not contain the address, operator website or plus code observed separately in the browser. No physical status is taken from the map.

sources.title: CASBEE certification: Goodman Business Park Stage 7
sources.publisher: Bureau Veritas Japan; hosted by the Institute for Built Environment and Carbon Neutral for SDGs
sources.attribution: Bureau Veritas Japan; hosted by the Institute for Built Environment and Carbon Neutral for SDGs
sources.summary: Original certification issued May 24, 2024 identifies Goodman Business Park Stage 7 new construction as a data center and office at Kaguro-Minami 2-chome 2-5, 2-8 and 2-9. The operator factsheet address 2-2-5 is included in that property address. The certificate supports an address and historical project-name bridge; it supplies no selected geometry. Its May 2024 completion date is explicitly planned and is not an achieved completion or current status.
